reason: Pre-lock rename (audit R2 item 11): each topic's prefix names its resource, so the gift card ledger resource transaction is gift_card_transaction (topic gift_card_transaction.created) with the same fields and protection; migration 0164 rewrites stored topics, grants, registrations and subscriptions.

change: order version: the field was removed.
reason: Pre-lock (audit L2): one optimistic-concurrency vocabulary. Every resource exposes `revision` and every write takes `expectedRevision`; orders, returns, reviews and gift cards exposed `version` (the same counter, now named revision). `stockVersion`/`expectedStockVersion` stay the one named exception: they guard a SKU's stock counter, not the resource.

change: truncation fetch: the response may now be null.
reason: Pre-lock (audit L8): a truncated delivery's `fetch` names a stable read an app can call (`appOperation`, its sealed app name, beside the HTTP `operationId`/`method`/`path`), and is null where no stable read returns that representation yet (purchase orders, inventory transfers, checkouts, reviews): the receiver keeps the `id`. The hints that named dashboard or beta operations (`dashboard.gift_cards.get`, `dashboard.orders.return_get`, `dashboard.reviews.get`, ...) would have answered `api_unknown_operation` to an app.

change: order lines[].purchaseOption: the field was removed.
reason: Pre-release (gap G3 follow-up, Nov 6 2026 server audit): a line carries one purchase option of each of several apps, so a single `purchaseOption` could only name the first by id; an app testing `line.purchaseOption === "<its option>"` would silently stop seeing its lines once a buyer added another app's option. The field is removed; `purchaseOptions` (sorted by id) lists every option and an app tests for its own with `includes`.

change: behaviour: purchase_order deliveries to an app's endpoint are cancelled (app_cost_scope_not_granted) while the app's live grant lacks read_product_costs.
reason: Pre-lock security fix (G2 review): a purchase order's representation carries the store's costs (unit, shipping, other and tax), which an app sees only with read_product_costs. An app's own webhook endpoint therefore gets purchase_order topics only while its live grant confers products.view_costs: creating or updating a subscription whose topics reach one (`*`, `purchase_order.*`, `purchase_order.updated`) without it is refused with 403 cost_scope_required (core events webhook-subscriptions.ts), and a delivery to an existing subscription whose grant lacks it is cancelled with app_cost_scope_not_granted before its representation is read (webhook-delivery.ts). The store's own endpoints are unchanged. A behaviour change, so no snapshot diff produces this entry: it records the break for review.

change: behaviour: conversation deliveries to an app's endpoint are cancelled (app_conversation_scope_not_granted) while the app's live grant lacks read_conversations.
reason: Pre-lock privacy fix (COMMERCE-HOOKS H18): a conversation's representation carries buyers' words and staff notes, which an app reads only with read_conversations. An app's own webhook endpoint therefore gets conversation topics only while its live grant confers conversations.view: creating or updating a subscription whose topics reach one (`*`, `conversation.*`, `conversation.message_received`) without it is refused with 403 conversation_scope_required (core events webhook-subscriptions.ts), and a delivery to an existing subscription whose grant lacks it is cancelled with app_conversation_scope_not_granted before its representation is read (webhook-delivery.ts). The store's own endpoints are unchanged. A behaviour change, so no snapshot diff produces this entry: it records the break for review.

change: object type: the field was removed.
reason: Pre-lock (Nov 9): a truncated object delivery points at objects.get, which answered another shape. The object representation is now the ObjectRecord objects.get answers: `type` is `typeId` (the same value, the type's id), and it gains displayName and position; status is sealed to OBJECT_STATUSES. The gift card and ledger entry representations gain the fields gift_cards.get answers (message, note, expired, reason) and seal their states.

change: behaviour: an order paid as it was placed (a point-of-sale sale, or marked paid by staff) carries paymentMethod manual and paymentTerms null in every order representation, not net_terms with terms.
reason: Pre-release (Nov 9 e2e finding M1): an order paid as it was placed was recorded as an invoice: payment method `net_terms` with 30-day terms and a due date, then paid in full right after. Buyers read "Pay later by invoice", analytics filed it under net_terms and an app saw `paymentTerms` on a paid order. It is now placed with payment method `manual` (RECORDED_PAYMENT_METHOD, the method its recorded payments already carried), `paymentTerms: null`, and its money is the recorded payments of their `via` (cash, card_terminal, mobile_wallet, bank_transfer, ...). An app that read `paymentMethod === "net_terms"` to find point-of-sale or marked-paid orders reads `manual` (or `channel: "pos"`). The field stays free text, so no schema diff produces this entry: it records the break for review. Such an order runs no `checkout.payment_methods` function (the money is already in). Migration 0207 rewrites the orders placed before the change (proven by their pos_sale fact, or by a full staff payment and its timeline line in the same request) to `manual` without enqueueing order.updated: apps learn of it through `updatedAt`.
